title: track: STATUS=SIZE deferred — blocked on imap-types upstream
description:
STATUS=SIZE (RFC 8438 / RFC 9051 §6.3.10) cannot be implemented with imap-types 2.0.0-alpha.6. StatusDataItemName and StatusDataItem have no Size variant and no Other escape hatch. The library parser will reject STATUS requests containing the SIZE item before the application sees them.

Blocked on: upstream imap-types adding StatusDataItemName::Size and StatusDataItem::Size(u64), tracked in the upstream GitHub issue filed as part of this epic.

When unblocked:
- Add StatusDataItemName::Size arm to handle_status() in mailbox.rs
- SQL: COALESCE(SUM(size_octets), 0) as i64, then u64::try_from() with warn on overflow
- Add Capability::try_from("STATUS=SIZE") to capability_list()
- Update e2e tests

Do not start this work until the imap-types upstream issue is resolved and a new alpha ships.
